title: DK 838 YG corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: DK 838 YG corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: DK 838 YG corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety. 100 to 104 days to harvest, 8.4 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: DK 838 YG corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2005 as NSIC 2005 GMCn 02. Monsanto bred it. It takes 100 to 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 8.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

items: **Days to harvest:** 100 to 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 8.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** anywhere in the country, in the dry season.

blocks.text: Key facts about DK 838 YG corn
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

DK 838 YG corn takes 100 to 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 3.4 days faster than the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 8.4 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
Where and when to plant DK 838 YG corn

The registry recommends it for anywhere in the country in the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 100 to 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 8.4 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of DK 838 YG?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
